facts.fact: A joint order of the digital economy minister and the economy and finance minister, signed 10 November 2015, created the Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI) project to promote releasing non-sensitive government data for reuse, with ANPTIC as executing agency; the order sets the project's closing date at 31 December 2019 unless otherwise provided, and the document states no later end or replacement.

systems.platform: a central platform for publishing data, named as an objective, not described as running
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Posts, with ANPTIC as executing agency; financial oversight by the Ministry of Economy and Finance
